report.title: FIFA Global Transfer Report 2025
report.scope: International transfers recorded in FIFA TMS; dedicated sections distinguish men's professional, women's professional and amateur football.
report.rounding: Figures are reproduced at FIFA's published precision. Association aggregates and fee totals are rounded.
report.limits: Historical 2025 report. Fee values are in USD and include fixed, conditional and release fees as declared in TMS.

release.title: International transfers reach historic high in 2025
release.scope: Official summary of the Global Transfer Report 2025.
release.rounding: Whole-transfer counts and rounded USD totals as published.
release.limits: Summary page; detailed definitions come from the report and methodology page.

methodology.title: FIFA transfer reports methodology
methodology.scope: Definitions for reporting periods, transfer dates, fees and transfer types.
methodology.rounding: The website states that displayed numbers are rounded.
methodology.limits: Website methodology applies to FIFA transfer reports and TMS transaction data.
